name: Jupiter Intelligence

stage: Private — Series C (last round: $54M Series C, 2021)

name: Carbon Mapper
category: Nonprofit satellite/airborne methane & CO2 MRV data
stage: Nonprofit 501(c)(3) — philanthropic/donor funded, no equity rounds
funding_summary: $100M total funding (LinkedIn). Funded by a coalition including Bloomberg Philanthropies (a $25M commitment in Oct 2021), High Tide Foundation, the State of California, NASA JPL, Planet, University of Arizona, ASU and RMI. Tanager-1, the coalition's first methane/CO2-sensing satellite, launched 16 Aug 2024.
headcount_source: LinkedIn company profile https://linkedin.com/company/carbon-mapper ('employs 43 people, +36.1% YoY, +13 people', $100M total funding, retrieved 2026-09-10); LeadIQ employee directory https://leadiq.com/c/carbon-mapper/63a3441a99142b48fdc14d06/employee-directory (11-50 range). Audited financial statements (FY2025) are public at assets.carbonmapper.org.
products: Methane and CO2 point-source detection and quantification: Tanager satellite constellation (JPL imaging spectrometer), airborne remote sensing surveys, and a public data portal publishing facility-scale plume and emission-rate data to drive emissions reductions.
icp_notes: Mission-driven data producer, not a commercial software buyer — but a strong partner: it supplies open methane/CO2 MRV data that a climate data/AI seller could integrate or co-market. Existing funders (Bloomberg Philanthropies, High Tide) and coalition members are better software buyers than Carbon Mapper itself.

name: Ember
category: Energy/climate data think tank (open electricity data and policy analysis)
stage: Nonprofit — not-for-profit think tank (community interest company in England & Wales), grant/donor funded
funding_summary: Philanthropy-funded: no equity or VC rounds. Reported to rely in part on overseas climate-focused donors (The Telegraph, 3 Jul 2026); annual revenue ~$24M (LinkedIn). Rebranded in 2020 from the Sandbag Climate Campaign (founded 2008).
headcount: 75 (LinkedIn company page, +23.2% YoY); an Aug 2025 job ad references an ~80-person team across 19 countries

products: Free/open electricity system data and analysis: global electricity data explorer and country dashboards, annual Global Electricity Review, coal-mine methane tracking, and policy insights/campaigns aimed at accelerating the clean electricity transition.

category: Environmental commodities trading & corporate climate solutions
stage: Private — PE-controlled; Partners Group acquired a controlling stake (late 2021)
funding_summary: Not venture-funded; majority controlled by Partners Group since late 2021 (per ownership analyses), following the 2021 majority acquisition of Vertis. icp_notes: Genuine buyer profile: a capital-markets-adjacent trading and advisory firm that needs market data, pricing/risk analytics and enterprise tooling (its own 'ClimateTech' platform), and that sells decarbonisation services to corporates — a natural account for a climate data/analytics/AI seller, and also a partner/channel into corporate energy buyers (STRIVE advisory).
